prose:
A second feed entry points to TestingCatalog's collection of rumored Opus 5.6 outputs. It carries the same examples and uncertainty as [the original article index](../summaries/8b39fa8ea2ac.md), not a second independent report.

Selected animations and tester labels cannot authenticate a model release. The article says there is no official confirmation and does not provide a systematic test across users, tasks or repeated runs. No code or media sample was executed.
highlights: Same source as the earlier article index
Examples are selected rather than systematic
